note: Every document, brief and instruction this site was built from, in the order it arrived. It exists for two jobs. First, nothing gets worked twice: `sha256` is the digest of the file exactly as received, so an identical file arriving again is recognisable before anybody starts reading it — `received` lists every time it turned up. Second, nothing gets missed: an agent producing these briefs can fetch this file, compare it against what it has sent, and name anything absent. `status` is the honest state of the work, not an intention. `produced` names what exists because of the item, with URLs that can be checked. Items given as speech, chat text or a link have no digest and are recorded under `informal` — they are the ones most easily lost, which is why they are in here at all.
maintained_by: RiskMandate. Corrections and omissions: use the contact control on the page.
